args.summary:
Bridge modeled: cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete single-cell box girder, 4 spans 30+40+40+30 m (bearing centre lines), deck width 16 m. Modeled as a 2D spine beam (MR-01) on a continuous_on_piers system (MR-05) since pier column geometry is given. Girder section (cast_box, B_top=16, B_bot=9, h=2, t_top=t_bot=0.25, t_web=0.5, cantilever 0.5→0.2) integrated to A=8.45 m², I=4.937 m⁴; C50 Ec=34500 MPa; owner unit weight γ=26.5 kN/m³ (MR-00 override) giving w=223.925 kN/m, m=22.826 t/m.

Supports: abutments 0 & 4 and piers 2 & 3 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (2/line; longitudinal free, Kh=0); pier 1 = fixed plain laminated (Kh=10909 kN/m). Bearing Kv computed per JTG 3362-2018 §8.7 (Ee=5.4·Ge·S², Ge=1.0 MPa): 3.14e6 / 8.03e6 / 7.18e6 / 7.18e6 / 3.14e6 kN/m. Piers 1–3 modeled as elastic beam-columns, twin Ø1.6 m C40 columns merged (A=4.021 m², I=0.643 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa), heights 25/28/6 m, fixed at base.

Live load: Class I, 4 design lanes (one-way, W=15 m), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/340/340/320 kN, ξ=0.67. Modal analysis gave f1=3.139 Hz, hence impact factor μ=0.1864 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Results: model built and all L1/L2/L3 checks passed. Self-weight reactions 2451/8658/9120/8686/2435 kN; peak sagging moments 11.6/15.8/15.6/11.3 MN·m; support moments −27.2/−30.7/−27.7 MN·m. Lane-load max positive moment 11.32 MN·m, max negative −8.97 MN·m. No unresolved issues.
